VBO:0200183.summary: Affectionate with their people and determined on a scent trail, Bluetick Coonhounds bring energy and persistence to nocturnal hunting. Their voice can change from a bawl, squall or bugle on the trail to a different call at the tree, helping hunters follow their progress. UKC began registering them separately from English Coonhounds in 1946.
VBO:0200183.shortDescription: Affectionate, persistent scenthounds whose changing trail and tree calls help hunters follow their work after dark.
